title: 10.3.0 | Terrifier Patch Notes
body:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/6681d9e31b64313b83ce96cf2482403e14c5bb9e.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Content[/b][/h2][h3][b]New Killer: The Terrifier[/b][/h3][p][b]POWER: BAG OF TOYS[/b]
Hold the Ability Button to open the [b]Bag of Toys[/b] and choose from [b]2 Toys[/b]. New [b]Toys[/b] are randomly available each time the bag is opened. Closing the bag triggers a 10s cooldown.[/p][p]
[b]SPECIAL ITEMS: TOYS[/b]
Each [b]Toy[/b] is single-use.

[b][u]Acid Bottle[/u][/b]
Hold Power Button to aim, then press Attack Button to throw an [b]Acid Bottle[/b] which breaks on impact, creating an [b]Acid Puddle[/b] that lasts for 1.5s. Inflicts [b]Torture[/b] on injured Survivors.
If a wall is hit with an [b]Acid Bottle[/b], a puddle will form at its base, so long as the impact point is below 8m.
[/p][p][b][u]Flamethrower[/u][/b]
Hold Power Button to ready, then press Attack Button to unleash a stream of [b]Flames.[/b] Inflicts [b]Torture[/b] on injured Survivors.
Burning [b]Flames[/b] ignite the environment for up to 6s, as well as Generators, Windows, and Downed Pallets for 6s.[/p][p][b][u]Handgun[/u][/b]
Hold Power Button to aim, then press Attack Button to fire a single round. Inflicts [b]Torture[/b] on injured Survivors.[/p][p][b][u]Flail
[/u][/b]Hold Power Button to wield the [b]Flail[/b], then press Attack Button to strike. Inflicts [b]Torture[/b] on injured Survivors.[/p][list][*][p]5m range.[/p][/*][*][p]Strikes over Window vaults, Pallets, and short objects.[/p][/*][/list][p][b][u]Bike Horn[/u][/b]
Hold Power Button to ready, then press Attack Button to squeeze the [b]Bike Horn,[/b] detecting Survivors within a 6m radius and an unlimited forward range.
A detected Survivor is revealed by a loud noise notification. If multiple Survivors are detected, they are afflicted with Oblivious and Killer Instinct reveals their locations.
When a Tortured Survivor is detected, the duration of their affliction is reset.
Unlike other Toys, the [b]Bike Horn[/b]'s [b]Deadliness[/b] increases when it detects multiple Survivors.
At maximum [b]Deadliness[/b], detected Survivors who are repairing or healing have their interactions interrupted with an instant 5% regression to repair progress and 5% regression to healing progress.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Toys[/b] damage healthy Survivors and inflict injured Survivors with [b]Torture[/b]. Hit a [b]Tortured[/b] Survivor with a different [b]Toy[/b] to down them.
Inflicting [b]Torture[/b] increases a [b]Toy[/b]'s [b]Deadliness[/b] by 1 point.
At maximum [b]Deadliness[/b], a [b]Toy[/b] both injures and inflicts [b]Torture[/b] on a healthy Survivor and downs injured Survivors. However, the amount of points for all other Toys to reach maximum [b]Deadliness[/b] increases by 1.[/p][p]The [b]Torture[/b] affliction lasts for 40s, or until the Survivor returns to a healthy state or is downed.[/p][p]The duration of [b]Torture[/b] is reset when hit by the same [b]Toy[/b].

[b]SPECIAL ACTION: TAUNT[/b]
When a different [b]Toy[/b] hits a [b]Tortured[/b] Survivor, they are downed and afflicted with [b]Terrified[/b].
Tap Ability Button within 6m of a [b]Terrified[/b] Survivor in the dying state to [b]Taunt[/b] them, increasing the [b]Deadliness[/b] of all [b]Toys[/b] by 1 point. This removes the Survivor’s [b]Terrified[/b] state.

Hooked Survivors will be automatically [b]Taunted[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][b]New Killer Perks:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Laughingstock[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Survivors within [b]12m [/b]of a completed Generator:[/p][list][*][p]Gain [b]Exhausted[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Gain [b]Oblivious[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]When they leave this range, the effect lingers for [b]3/4/5s[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]You see the Auras of completed Generators.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Kill Spree[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]When all remaining Survivors have 2 Hook States and all Generators are completed, you can kill Survivors.[/p][/*][*][p]While killing a Survivor,[b] [/b]both Exit Gate Switches are blocked. Whenever you finish killing a Survivor, this ends after [b]12/16/20s[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Funny Business[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Whenever you damage a Generator, you gain [b]10%[/b] [b]Haste [/b]for [b]10s [/b]and one of the following occurs at random:[/p][list][*][p]You retain your [b]10%[/b] [b]Haste [/b]for [b]5s [/b]longer.[/p][/*][*][p]You get stunned for [b]2s[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]The affected Generator is blocked for [b]30s[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Confetti! But nothing happens.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Cooldown: [b]60/50/40s[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]The same effect cannot happen twice in a row.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]New Survivor: Sienna Shaw[/b][/h3][p][b]New Survivor Perks:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Valkyrie's Rage[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]After being chased for [b]40/35/30s[/b], the next time you pallet-stun the Killer, they are stunned for [b]75%[/b] longer.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Shared Trauma[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Whenever you take a protection hit, all Survivors within [b]12m [/b]recover from [b]Exhausted [/b]while running for [b]30/35/40s[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Within [b]32m[/b], you see the Auras of [b]Exhausted [/b]Survivors.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Best Gift Ever[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]At the start of the trial, you earn [b]4/5/6 Tokens[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]The first time you drop an Item of each type, spend [b]1 Token[/b], then the dropped item is consumed (by the Entity). Then, based on the item type:[/p][list][*][p]Flashlight - Whenever you stun the Killer, they are also blinded for [b]2s[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fog Vial - Whenever you fast-vault, for [b]5s[/b], your scratch marks disappear [b]50%[/b] faster.[/p][/*][*][p]Key - You gain [b]+1 [/b]rummage on each chest.[/p][/*][*][p]Map - Auras you see for a duration last [b]+1s[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Medkit - While healing another Survivor, you also gain healing progress at [b]25%[/b] speed.[/p][/*][*][p]Toolbox - You see the Auras of the [b]3 [/b]Generators closest to each other.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]New Map: Hartshorne Mall[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Introducing The Subdivisions realm with the Hartshorne Mall, a new environment loaded with lore where players can experience a new environment in Dead by Daylight.
"Dwight was no older than five when he lost his parents in the Hartshorne Mall. A place that was once a magical escape twisted into something more horrifying. He ducked behind a door marked 'Employees Only', and found himself somewhere completely different: somewhere quiet, but no less disturbing. Something called out to him. He followed the call... and woke up at home, his parents pleading him to tell where he went. He did not answer. He could not remember."[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/3fba5ae864552d07cb8aeee138bf21a278496594.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Content Updates[/b][/h2][p][i]With the 10.2.0 patch, we released a lot of perk updates. We're making a few changes to some of them. We were conservative with some of the numbers and after reviewing, we felt they could be buffed further.[/i][/p][h3][b]Survivor Perk Updates[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Dark Sense[/b][/p][list][*][p]When the trial starts, and after a Generator is completed, you earn [b]1 Token[/b], up to [b]5[/b]. [i](NEW)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]When the Killer gets within [b]20m [/b]of you, spend [b]1[/b] [b]Token[/b]. Then, for the next [b]13/14/15s[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]You see the Aura of Pallets and Windows within [b]32m[/b][/p][/*][*][p]You see the Auras of other Survivors.[/p][/*][*][p]You see the Killer's Aura.
[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][i]Dev note: Dark Sense was updated as a generic alternative to reveal pallets and windows within a radius. In 10.2.0, it activated upon generator completion, meaning if it didn't get a chance to trigger, players would lose value. With this PTB, we are adding a token system to allow players to have more chances to activate the perk.[/i][/p][list][*][p][b]Calm Spirit[/b][/p][list][*][p]You do not scare Crows or scream.[/p][/*][*][p]You bless and cleanse Totems, and unlock Chests silently, and [b]23/24/25%[/b] faster. [i](was 8/9/10%)[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Slippery Meat[/b][/p][list][*][p]Other Survivors unhook you [b]65/70/75%[/b] faster. [i](was 90/95/100%)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Whenever you are unhooked, you gain [b]7%[/b] more [b]Haste[/b]. [i](was 5%)[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][i]Dev note: Slippery Meat had the possibility to eliminate risk for the Survivor unhooking you. With this PTB, we are shifting some of its strength from the Unhook Speed to the Haste bonus after being Unhooked.[/i][/p][h3][b]Killer Perk Updates[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Dark Arrogance[/b][/p][list][*][p]You basic-vault Windows [b]15%[/b] faster. [i](was 15/20/25%)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Your successful basic-attack cooldown is [b]13/14/15%[/b] shorter. [i](was all forms of basic-attack recovery and 10%)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Whenever you are blinded or Pallet-stunned the duration is [b]15%[/b] longer. [i](was 25%)[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][i]Dev note: Dark Arrogance regained its successful basic-attack cooldown in 10.2.2, but we felt it could be buffed a little further. To offset this, we're reducing the vault speed bonus while also decreasing the penalty to blinds and pallet stuns.[/i][/p][list][*][p][b]Scourge Hook: Monstrous Shrine[/b]
[/p][list][*][p]When the trial starts:[/p][list][*][p][b]4[/b] random hooks become Scourge Hooks.[/p][/*][*][p]The Basement Hooks become Scourge Hooks.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]While you are at least [b]24m [/b]away from a Survivor on a Scourge Hook, Generators not being repaired regress at [b]200%[/b] speed. [i](was 150/175/200%)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]When the Survivor is no longer hooked this effect ends in [b]20/25/30s[/b]. [i](NEW)[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Ravenous[/b][/p][list][*][p]The first time you hook each Survivor, you earn [b]1 Token[/b]. For each token:[/p][list][*][p]Gain [b]4% Haste[/b] while carrying Survivors.[/p][/*][*][p]Hook Survivors [b]4%[/b] faster.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]When you have [b]4 Tokens[/b], all Survivors:[/p][list][*][p]Scream.[/p][/*][*][p]Gain Exposed for [b]60/65/70s[/b]. [i](was 80/85/90s)[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][i]Dev note: Once upon a time, Vigil drastically decreased a lot of status effects, including Exposed. In a post-Vigil world, we felt the Exposed duration was a little too long.[/i][/p][list][*][p][b]Whispers[/b][/p][list][*][p]While within [b]28/26/24m[/b] of a Survivor, you randomly hear whispers.[/p][/*][*][p]While outside of [b]28/26/24m[/b] of a Survivor, you gain [b]7% Haste[/b]. [i](was 5%)[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/3fba5ae864552d07cb8aeee138bf21a278496594.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Features[/b][/h2][h3][b]Gore Customization[/b][/h3][p]You can now customize the gore settings under the Gameplay tab in the Settings menu.[/p][list][*][p][b]Death Sequences[/b] can be toggled to reduce their goriness.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Natural Blood Color[/b] can be toggled to a neutral green tone.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Regional Streamer Mode[/b], in addition to toggling the above, will anonymize all player information.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Mori System Update[/b][/h3][p]We have defined three distinct Mori categories to provide better activation constraints and also allow more flexibility in their artistic direction. These categories are:[/p][list][*][p]Finisher Mori[/p][/*][*][p]Power Mori[/p][/*][*][p]Memento Mori offering and Perk Mori[/p][/*][/list][p]Starting with The Terrifier, all upcoming Killers will adhere to this Mori system update.[/p][list][*][p][b]NOTE:[/b] Not all Killers have or will have a Power Mori, but rather that any Moris they do have will fall into these categories.[/p][/*][/list][p]Each Mori type is superseded by the one above it, as long as the trigger conditions are all met, meaning only a single "Kill" interaction prompt is available at one time.[/p][p]Activating all Moris will use a standardized keybinding of the Killer's Attack input.[/p][p]This system update will roll out to previously released Killers over time.[/p][h3][b]Rummage[/b][/h3][p]With the introduction of several effects that allow Survivors to rummage chests, we wanted to make a slight improvement to the way these effects interacted together.[/p][list][*][p]Removed the Rummage limit applied to each Chest. [i](was "could only Rummage each chest a maximum of 1 time")[/i][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Systems[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Implemented unified friends list.[/p][/*][*][p]Implemented Discord Account Integration.[/p][/*][*][p]Implemented Gore adjustment settings.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]UI[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Integration polish on the Friends List.[/p][/*][*][p]Polish on Terrifier's Tool Widget.[/p][/*][*][p]Made some improvements to the Blood Web.[/p][/*][*][p]Visual improvements to the Tally screen.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/3fba5ae864552d07cb8aeee138bf21a278496594.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2][h3][b]Audio[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where Sienna Shaw's Survivor-only
